responsibility: Implements checked fixed-width integer arithmetic primitives for the D front end’s support library. It provides signed and unsigned add, subtract, negate, and multiply helpers for 32-bit and 64-bit integers that return the machine-width result while setting a sticky overflow flag whenever the exact mathematical result does not fit, supporting semantic computations that must detect overflow without changing ordinary arithmetic conventions.
same_name_distinction: Contains the executable checked-arithmetic routines for signed and unsigned add/subtract/negate/multiply, including the overflow-detection logic; unlike checkedint.h, it is the implementation of those helpers rather than their declarations.
